title: MemMend: A Selective Revision Framework for Memory Question Answering
title_zh: MemMend：面向记忆问答的选择性修订框架
abstract_en: Revising every answer from a long-term memory can consume substantial inference budget and damage facts that were already correct. We introduce MemMend, a modular selective revision framework that routes potentially incomplete answers to an editor, represents corrections as bounded exact-text replacements, and accepts only edits with resolvable source coordinates and valid edit operations. The editor preserves the current answer when no legal repair is proposed; accepted edits require no additional semantic-verification call. On 1,986 LoCoMo development questions, MemMend achieves 67.17 conversation-macro F1 and 88.35 mean Judge score, improving over a verified revision chain by 0.82 and 1.24 points while using 62.37% fewer revision calls. Routing uses 54.15% fewer revision calls than ungated local review, with similar F1 but a 0.67-point lower Judge score. Applied directly to native PropMem, Mem0, and SimpleMem answers, the editing interface raises F1 by 3.79, 6.44, and 0.42 points. It outperforms same-gate rewriting and saves 49.85-83.72% of editing calls relative to ungated editing, which retains higher F1 in this adaptation. A source-by-editing factorial supports local editing for F1 but leaves an independent quality benefit from source obligations unresolved. Transfer to 451 LongMemEval-V2 Small questions also favors revision efficiency, while an external PerLTQA dialogue subset reveals a completeness gap. These results support selective editing as a reusable quality-cost operating point.
abstract_zh: 逐一修订基于长期记忆生成的答案，不仅消耗推理预算，还可能改坏原本正确的事实。MemMend 只将可能不完整的答案交给编辑器，把修正限制为对原答案中明确片段的精确文本替换。系统仅接受来源坐标可解析、操作合法的编辑；若没有合法修正，则保留原答案。通过检查的编辑无须额外调用模型进行语义验证。在 LoCoMo 的 1,986 道开发集问题上，MemMend 的对话宏平均 F1 为 67.17，平均 Judge 得分为 88.35，较带验证的修订链分别提高 0.82 和 1.24 分，同时减少 62.37% 的修订调用。相比不设门控的局部审查，选择性路由减少 54.15% 的修订调用，F1 相近，但 Judge 得分低 0.67 分。直接编辑 PropMem、Mem0 和 SimpleMem 的原生答案，分别使 F1 提高 3.79、6.44 和 0.42 分；在相同门控下，局部编辑优于重写。与无门控编辑相比，选择性编辑减少 49.85%–83.72% 的编辑调用，但无门控编辑在这一适配实验中仍取得更高的 F1。析因实验支持局部编辑能改善 F1，但尚不能确定来源约束是否独立提升质量。在 LongMemEval-V2 Small 的 451 道问题上，修订效率优势也得到体现；外部 PerLTQA 对话子集则暴露出答案完整性不足。
key_points_zh: 只将可能不完整的答案交给编辑器；若无合法的局部替换，则保留原答案，通过检查的编辑无须再做语义验证。
在 LoCoMo 上，相比带验证的修订链，F1 和 Judge 得分分别提高 0.82 和 1.24 分，修订调用减少 62.37%。
同一门控下，局部编辑优于整段重写；适配 PropMem、Mem0 和 SimpleMem 时，门控节省近一半至逾八成的编辑调用，但 F1 低于无门控编辑。
LongMemEval-V2 Small 验证了修订效率优势，PerLTQA 则暴露出完整性短板；来源约束能否独立提升质量仍未确定。
